en.设备、项目和根目录均来自主服务核验的当前目录。保存后由服务端登记独立执行身份。: Devices, projects, and roots come from the service's currently verified directory. The server registers an independent execution identity when saved.
en.设置已保存，通道仍待核对；可刷新通道: Settings saved. Check or refresh the notification channel.
en.设置已保存，通道核对暂未完成；可刷新通道: Settings saved. Channel verification is incomplete; you can refresh it.
en.该地址没有可用的任务主服务: No task service is available at this address
en.该账户草稿和原操作记录保留在原服务与账户范围内。: This account's drafts and original operation records remain scoped to the original service and account.
en.语音处理未能跟上录音，已停止听写并保留草稿，请重试。: Speech processing could not keep up. Dictation stopped and your draft is preserved. Try again.
en.语音识别权限未开启，请在系统设置中允许语音识别。: Speech recognition permission is off. Allow it in system settings.
en.请优化输入框，保留中文、换行和标点。\n: Optimize the input field while preserving Chinese, newlines, and punctuation.
en.请先上传全部附件，或移除不提交的草稿附件。: Upload all attachments first, or remove draft attachments you do not want to submit.
en.请先保存默认铃声选择。: Save the default sound selection first.
en.请先在客户端菜单连接这台执行电脑及对应 Agent 机器身份，再打开执行对话: Connect this execution computer and its Agent machine identity from the client menu before opening its conversation
en.请先在桌面授权项目目录: Authorize the project directory on the desktop first
en.请先处理当前草稿，再恢复原消息。当前草稿已保留。: Handle the current draft before restoring the original message. The current draft is preserved.
en.请先查询当前提交结果，再切换人类账户: Check the current submission result before switching human accounts
en.请先核对主服务冲突: Resolve the task service conflict first
en.请先核对原上传回执，不能重复上传: Check the original upload receipt first. Duplicate uploads are not allowed.
en.请先确认任务 AI 数据共享目标。允许后再次点击原提交按钮；当前内容未提交。: Confirm task AI sharing targets first. After allowing, tap the original submit button again. Current content was not submitted.
en.请先结束本机等待或取得回执，再退出账户: Stop waiting locally or obtain the receipt before signing out
en.请在 EasyWork 桌面确认目录授权，然后重试。: Approve directory access on the EasyWork desktop, then try again.
en.请在尚未添加真实电脑的新安装中导入迁移文件，现有连接未更改。: Import migration files into a new installation before adding real computers. Existing connections were not changed.
en.请在服务设置核对身份。新提交与派发已暂停，原主服务保持绑定。: Check its identity in service settings. New submissions and dispatches are paused; the original service remains bound.
en.请在系统设置中允许 Agent Hub 的通知。: Allow Agent Hub notifications in system settings.
en.请填写局域网或 VPN 电脑地址: Enter the computer's local network or VPN address
en.请打开核对业务提醒: Open to verify the business alert
en.请扫描或粘贴桌面的局域网配对二维码: Scan or paste the desktop's local network pairing QR code
en.请更新电脑端后使用直接连接: Update the computer software before using a direct connection
en.请更新这台电脑的 Host 后使用直接连接: Update this computer's Host before using a direct connection
en.请连接原主服务并登录后上传: Connect to the original task service and sign in before uploading
en.请连接原主服务并登录后提交；草稿已保留: Connect to the original service and sign in before submitting. Your draft is preserved.
en.请连接原主服务并重新登录。: Connect to the original task service and sign in again.
en.请选择 WAV、AIFF、CAF、M4A 或 MP3 音频。: Choose WAV, AIFF, CAF, M4A, or MP3 audio.
en.请选择不超过 29 秒的短铃声。: Choose a short sound no longer than 29 seconds.
en.请选择准确电脑、项目和根目录: Choose the exact computer, project, and root directory
en.请选择非空且不超过 20 MB 的文件。: Choose a nonempty file no larger than 20 MB.
en.请重新核对原主服务、人类会话和项目权限后提交: Verify the original service, human session, and project permissions before submitting
en.跟随电脑的许可涵盖该目标的 AI 配置后续调整。撤回只影响本机后续提交，不删除已: Permission to use computer settings covers future AI configuration changes for that target. Revocation only affects later submissions from this device; it neither deletes sent content nor stops dispatched computer workflows.
en.跟随电脑表示允许该目标使用电脑端当前及之后调整的 AI 配置；这里没有承诺某个固: Using computer settings allows the target's current AI configuration and future changes; it does not promise a fixed model or provider. Check the provider, retention, training use, and processing region on the computer. Confirm again when the Agent or machine runtime target changes. Codex account changes do not change machine permission; other Agents retain their own account rules.
en.转写仍在处理中，录音已保留；点击重试查询原结果。: Transcription is still processing. Recording preserved; tap Retry to query the original result.
en.转写回执与原录音或目标不一致: The transcription receipt differs from the original recording or target
en.轮次已改变，请关闭表单并进入当前轮；旧草稿继续保留。: The round changed. Close this form and open the current round. Your older draft is preserved.
en.输入回复或补充说明: Enter a reply or additional details
en.迁移密码至少需要 12 个字符。: Migration passwords need at least 12 characters.
en.迁移文件过大。: The migration file is too large.
en.迁移铃声格式无效。: The migrated sound format is invalid.
en.这一轮尚未缓存，连接原主服务后读取。: This round is not cached. Connect to the original service to read it.
en.这些许可属于本机当前任务主服务和人类账户。聊天连接的许可独立管理。允许后由你再次: These permissions belong to this device's current task service and human account. Chat connection permissions are managed separately. Submit again after allowing; unknown results only query the original receipt.
en.这份备份不属于当前 App 或受支持的旧版本，现有数据未更改。: This backup does not belong to this app or a supported older version. Existing data was not changed.
en.这台电脑的旧草稿或原回执范围有冲突，全部记录已保留。核对原记录后再提交；不会覆盖: Older drafts or receipts for this computer have conflicting scopes. All records are preserved. Check them before submitting; the current draft will not be overwritten and unknown operations will not be replayed.
en.这是本地示例对话，可以继续输入文字或选择附件来体验界面。: This is a local demo conversation. Enter text or choose attachments to try the interface.
en.这条通知属于另一服务或人类账户，请先连接原服务并核对登录: This notification belongs to another service or account. Connect to the original service and check your login.
en.这条通知的连接已移除或身份已变化。: This notification's connection was removed or its identity changed.
en.这里只添加本地示例项目。: Only local demo projects are added here.
en.这项操作的结果尚未确认，请先查询原回执: This operation's result is unconfirmed. Query the original receipt first.
en.连接、草稿和回执已恢复。通知已关闭，请先核对电脑身份再开启。: Connections, drafts, and receipts restored. Notifications are off; verify computer identities before enabling them.
en.连接主服务后创建业务项目。: Connect to the task service to create a business project.
en.连接主服务后可以查看证据附件: Connect to the task service to view evidence attachments
en.连接信息无效或已过期，请在桌面重新生成: Connection information is invalid or expired. Generate it again on the desktop.
en.连接原主服务后可撤销设备会话: Connect to the original task service to revoke device sessions
en.连接原主服务后才能下载证据附件。: Connect to the original service to download evidence attachments.
en.连接原主服务后重试。离线时仅显示已保存的任务。: Connect to the original service and try again. Only saved tasks are shown offline.
en.连接程序返回了不兼容的数据。: The connection software returned incompatible data.
en.连接结果待确认，消息仍保留在草稿中；再次发送会先查询连接状态。: Connection result unconfirmed. Your message remains in the draft; sending again will first check the connection status.
en.选择会记住，供此客户端的新对话使用。设置随下一条消息或排队消息提交，补充指令沿用: Your selection is remembered for new conversations on this client. Settings are submitted with the next sent or queued message; additional instructions use the current task settings.
en.选择电脑授权工作目录中的已有文件夹。: Choose an existing folder in the computer's authorized working directory.
en.通知原任务或轮次尚未确认，未切换页面: The notification's original task or round is unconfirmed. The page was not changed.
en.通知属于另一服务或账户，请先连接原服务并核对登录: This notification belongs to another service or account. Connect to the original service and check your login first.
en.通知设置尚未确认；当前仅提供前台补齐: Notification settings are unconfirmed. Only foreground updates are available.
en.通知账户与当前登录不同；须重新核对原服务及账户: The notification account differs from the current login. Check the original service and account.
en.通知项目当前无权访问: You cannot access this notification's project right now
en.部分电脑的通知撤销待联网同步。: Notification revocation for some computers will sync when online.
en.铃声文件最多 10 MB。: Sound files must be no larger than 10 MB.
en.附件字节或 SHA-256 与登记不一致: Attachment bytes or SHA-256 differ from the registered values
en.需求变化由服务端形成反馈或新轮次；已有验收不会被静默沿用。: The server records requirement changes as feedback or new rounds. Existing acceptance will not be silently reused.
en.需要连接原桌面运行时，历史连接不能创建分支: Connect to the original desktop runtime to branch. History connections cannot create branches.
en.音频已损坏或无法解码，请选择其他音频。: The audio is damaged or cannot be decoded. Choose another file.
en.音频已损坏或无法转换。: The audio is damaged or cannot be converted.
en.音频没有可播放的内容。: The audio has no playable content.
en.项目和根目录已变化，请重新读取真实目录: The project and root directory changed. Reload the actual directory.
en.项目尚未保存，无法核对实际 Agent 目标；请先创建项目并设置映射: The project is not saved, so the actual Agent target cannot be verified. Create the project and configure its mapping first.
en.预览标题、任务摘要与问题内容: Preview titles, task summaries, and questions
en.首条附件已变化，原创建内容已保留。: The first-message attachments changed. The original content is preserved.
en.首次输入桌面设置的连接密码，之后自动重连。: Enter the connection password set on the desktop once, then reconnect automatically.
en.首次连接扫描电脑二维码，之后自动发现局域网与 VPN 入口。: Scan the computer's QR code once. Local network and VPN endpoints are discovered automatically afterward.
en.麦克风已被系统静音。: The microphone is muted by the system.
en.麦克风已被系统静音，请解除静音后重试。原草稿已保留。: The microphone is muted by the system. Unmute it and try again. Your draft is preserved.
en.麦克风未提供音频，听写已停止。请检查系统麦克风及通话、其他录音占用后重试。原草稿: No microphone audio was received, so dictation stopped. Check the system microphone and other calls or recordings, then try again. Your draft is preserved.
en.麦克风权限未开启，请在系统设置中允许访问麦克风。: Microphone permission is off. Allow microphone access in system settings.
en.跟随系统，或选择中文和英文。更改会立即生效。: Follow the system, or choose Chinese or English. Changes take effect immediately.
en.本地数据密钥不可用，已保留原数据。: The local data key is unavailable. Your original data is preserved.
en.原有连接、草稿和聊天已保留。请解锁设备后重试，恢复前不会保存空数据。: Your connections, drafts, and chats are preserved. Unlock the device and retry. Empty data will not be saved before recovery.
en.此对话已归档，恢复后可继续。: This chat is archived. Restore it to continue.
en.将同步删除电脑端的原始聊天，无法恢复。仅想保留历史时请选择归档。: This also deletes the original desktop chat and cannot be undone. Choose Archive to keep its history.
en.未发送操作：无法保存本地记录。: Operation not sent: the local record could not be saved.
en.操作结果待确认，请在对话选项中查询原记录。: The result is unknown. Check the original operation in chat options.
en.搜索消息、工具输出或附件名称: Search messages, tool output, or attachment names
en.无法读取完整历史。可搜索已缓存内容；连接恢复后重试。: Full history could not be read. Search cached content or retry when connected.
en.仅解除本机等待，原操作仍可查询，不会取消电脑端操作或重新提交。: This only ends the local wait. The original operation remains queryable; it is not canceled or resubmitted.
en.当前电脑连接暂不支持归档、恢复或删除已加载的聊天。: This computer connection cannot yet archive, restore, or delete chats loaded in the desktop app.
en.显示会话标题与待处理概要: Show conversation titles and action summaries
en.请打开对话核对已提交操作是否执行，避免重复提交: Open the conversation to check whether the submitted operation ran before submitting again
en.通知优先显示会话标题，正文显示待审批操作、具体问题、待确认计划或需要核对的原操作: Notifications lead with the conversation title. The body describes the operation awaiting approval, specific question, plan, or original submission to check. Content previews are on by default for new settings; existing off choices are preserved. With previews off, only the computer and notification type appear. The badge counts unread conversations on this phone independently of computer reading. Time Sensitive notifications follow system permissions and Focus settings.
en.任务进行中或有待回答问题，暂不可归档: Task running or awaiting an answer. Archive when it finishes.
en.从此电脑的项目列表移除，保留文件和对话。: Remove projects from this computer’s list. Files and chats are kept.
en.归档后从活跃列表移除，可在电脑端恢复。: Archived chats leave the active list. Restore them on your computer.
en.此客户端尚未支持此操作，请更新电脑连接程序或切换客户端。: This client does not support this action yet. Update the computer connection service or switch clients.
en.电脑离线，连接后可批量管理。: This computer is offline. Connect to manage items.
en.每批最多选择 100 项。全选仅选择当前搜索结果。: Select up to 100 items per batch. Select all applies to the current search results.
en.管理目标已变化，请重新选择。: The target has changed. Select items again.
en.仅移除此电脑的项目记录，文件和对话历史会保留。: Only project records on this computer will be removed. Files and chat history will be kept.
en.所选对话将从活跃列表移除，历史会保留。: Selected chats will leave the active list. History will be kept.
en.所选内容还有待核对的操作，请先核对结果。: Selected items have an operation awaiting confirmation. Check its results first.
en.批量操作结果尚未确认，请使用“核对结果”查询原操作。: Results are not confirmed yet. Use “Check results” to look up the original operation.
en.原桌面正在占用此对话，请在桌面归档: The desktop owns this chat. Archive it on the desktop.
en.此客户端未开放立即执行队列: This client does not support running queued messages now
en.队列操作结果待核对，请刷新原任务: Queue action needs confirmation. Refresh the original task.
en.此文件尚未由电脑提供，请刷新对话后重试。: The computer has not provided this file. Refresh the conversation and try again.
en.手机上没有可打开此链接的应用。: No app on this phone can open this link.
en.这是电脑上的本地文件，手机不能直接访问。请刷新对话；文件须存在、位于电脑授权目录: This file is on the computer and cannot be opened directly on your phone. Refresh the conversation. To download and preview it, the file must exist, be within the computer’s authorized directories, and be no larger than 20 MB.
en.此网址指向电脑的本机地址，手机无法直接访问。请使用手机可连接的局域网或 VPN: This URL points to the computer’s loopback address. Use a LAN or VPN URL that your phone can reach.
en.手机暂不支持此类链接，可复制后在对应应用中打开。: This link type is not supported on your phone. Copy it to open in a compatible app.
en.网页未能加载，请检查手机网络或网址。: The webpage could not load. Check your phone’s network connection or the URL.
en.归档后从活跃列表移除，可在已归档对话中恢复。: Archived chats leave the active list. Restore them from Archived Chats.
en.原草稿将被替换，填入后仍可编辑。: Your draft will be replaced. You can still edit it before sending.
en.未能取得此对话的最新进度，当前显示缓存。正在自动重试。: Could not get the latest progress for this conversation. Showing cached messages and retrying automatically.
en.已从电脑同步最新历史进度，正在重试实时连接。: Latest history synced from your computer. Retrying the live connection.
en.当前进度正从电脑实时同步；完整桌面状态暂不可用，较早历史按需加载。: Current progress is streaming from your computer. Full desktop state is unavailable; earlier history loads on demand.
en.电脑已继续后续任务。这条旧消息是否执行仍缺少确认，不代表当前任务在等待；不会自动: Your computer has continued with later tasks. This earlier message remains unconfirmed; the current task is not waiting and the message will not be resent automatically.
en.连接器待发送 · 尚未进入电脑队列: Connector pending · Not in desktop queue
en.手机阅读状态暂未保存：通知更新繁忙，将在下次刷新时重试。: Reading status could not be saved while notifications are updating. It will retry on the next refresh.
en.手机阅读状态暂未保存：后台保存已中断，将在回到 App 后重试。: Reading status could not be saved because background saving was interrupted. It will retry when you return to the app.
en.无法保存手机阅读状态：设备存储空间不足。: Reading status could not be saved: device storage is full.
en.无法保存手机阅读状态（%@，%@ %@）。已有记录已保留，请稍后重试。: Reading status could not be saved (%@, %@ %@). Existing records are preserved. Please retry later.
en.无法保存手机阅读状态，已有记录已保留，请稍后重试。: Reading status could not be saved. Existing records are preserved. Please retry later.
en.客户端队列不可用，消息未提交。可保留草稿，或自行选择立即追加。: The client queue is unavailable. Your message has not been submitted. Keep the draft or choose to add it to the current task.
en.输入电脑显示的连接码，再在已登录的电脑上确认此设备。手机无需登录账号。: Enter the connection code shown on your computer, then approve this device on the signed-in computer. You do not need to sign in on your phone.
en.设备尚未配对，请在电脑上确认授权: This device is not paired yet. Approve it on your computer.
en.录音设备准备超时，请检查麦克风后重试。原草稿已保留。: The recording device took too long to get ready. Check your microphone and try again. Your original draft is preserved.
en.暂时无法连接电脑: Unable to connect to your computer
en.与电脑的安全连接未能建立。请确认电脑已联网、连接服务正在运行，稍后再试；若仍无法: A secure connection to your computer could not be established. Make sure the computer is online and its connection service is running, then try again. If the problem continues, check the connection settings on the computer.
en.暂时无法验证这台电脑的安全连接。请在电脑端检查连接设置后重试；如果最近重新配置过: The secure connection to this computer could not be verified. Check the connection settings on the computer and try again. If you recently set up the connection again, remove and add the computer again.
en.手机当前没有可用的网络。请检查 Wi-Fi 或移动网络；如果通过 VPN 连接，: Your phone has no available network connection. Check Wi-Fi or cellular data. If you use a VPN to connect, make sure it is connected too.
en.连接电脑超时。请确认电脑已开机并联网，且连接服务正在运行，然后重试。: The connection to your computer timed out. Make sure the computer is on and online and its connection service is running, then try again.
en.暂时无法连接这台电脑。请确认电脑已开机并联网，且连接服务正在运行；如果通过 VP: Your computer is currently unreachable. Make sure it is on and online and its connection service is running. If you use a VPN to connect, make sure it is connected too.
en.与电脑的连接已中断。请检查手机和电脑的网络，连接恢复后再试。: The connection to your computer was interrupted. Check the network on your phone and computer, then try again once the connection is restored.
en.聊天历史已变化，请刷新后重试。: Chat history has changed. Refresh and try again.
en.加载历史失败，请重试。\n: Could not load history. Try again.
en.读取对话超时，已有消息和草稿已保留。: Reading this conversation timed out. Your messages and draft are preserved.
en.将同步删除电脑端的原始聊天及其子对话，无法恢复。仅想保留历史时请选择归档。: This permanently deletes the original desktop chat and its subagent chats. This cannot be undone. Choose Archive to keep its history.
en.电脑端拒绝了此次操作：当前连接暂不支持管理桌面已加载的对话，请在桌面端操作。对话: The desktop rejected this action: this connection cannot yet manage chats loaded on the desktop. Use the desktop app. The chat is unchanged.
en.电脑端拒绝了此次归档：当前连接暂不支持管理桌面已加载的对话，请在桌面端操作。对话: The desktop rejected archiving: this connection cannot yet manage chats loaded on the desktop. Use the desktop app. The chat is unchanged.
en.未发送操作：目标已变化。: Operation not sent: the target changed.
en.未查到原聊天操作记录，结果仍未确认；不会重新提交。: The original chat operation record was not found. Its result remains unconfirmed; it will not be submitted again.
